This writ petition is directed against the order dated 07.03.2019 passed by the Special Land Acquisition Officer, rejecting the application under Section 28A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, filed by the petitioner seeking for enhanced compensation as per the Reference Court award dated 22.04.2018.

2. The impugned order categorically records that the writ petitioner herein has sold his right and interest in the land in question by way of the sale deed dated 15.06.2007 in favour of a third party.

sentences.text: This finding returned by the competent authority while rejecting the application under section 28A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, is not subjected to challenge, inasmuch as the factum of execution of sale deed dated 15.06.2007 is admitted to the writ petition.
4. The said sale deed had been executed after the publication of the notification under section 4 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.

Once the petitioner has parted away with his right and interest in the property by execution of the sale deed, i.e his right to receive compensation or enhanced compensation, he cannot claim for extra compensation determined by the reference court under section 28A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
The petitioner will not fall within the meaning of 'persons interested' as stated in section 28A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
5. For the aforesaid, we do not find any merit in the writ petition.
